notes.title: accidentally
notes.summary_cn: 某事并非有意计划，却意外发生。
notes.summary_en: Accidentally means by mistake or without intending for something to happen.

notes.title: afterward
notes.summary_cn: 在某件事发生之后；后来。
notes.summary_en: Afterward means at a later time, after an event or action has finished.

notes.title: algorithm
notes.summary_cn: 为解决问题或完成计算而设计的一组明确、有序的规则或步骤。
notes.summary_en: An algorithm is a clear set of ordered rules or steps that a computer or person follows to solve a problem.

notes.title: alter
notes.summary_cn: 改变、改动：使性质、外观、计划或结果有所不同，通常不强调彻底替换。
notes.summary_en: To alter something is to change part of it so that it becomes different, while it often remains the same basic thing.

notes.title: alternatively
notes.summary_cn: 引出与前一种方案不同的另一个选择。
notes.summary_en: Alternatively introduces another choice or a different way of doing something.

notes.title: ambition
notes.summary_cn: 强烈希望取得成就的愿望。
notes.summary_en: Ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, or a particular goal that someone hopes to reach.

notes.title: apart from
notes.summary_cn: 表示排除某人或某物，相当于 except for。
notes.summary_en: Apart from can mean “except for” or “in addition to.” It can also describe being separated from someone or something.

notes.title: apparent
notes.summary_cn: 明显的、显而易见的：容易看出或理解。
notes.summary_en: Apparent can mean clearly visible or easy to understand, but it can also describe something that only seems true based on current appearances.

notes.title: appreciation
notes.summary_cn: 对帮助或善意的感激；对价值、美感或质量的欣赏。
notes.summary_en: Appreciation is gratitude, recognition of value or quality, or a clear understanding of something. In finance, it can mean an increase in value.

notes.title: approximately
notes.summary_cn: 数量、时间或程度接近某个值，但并非完全精确。
notes.summary_en: Approximately means close to a number, amount, or time, but not exactly equal to it.

notes.title: archaeologist
notes.summary_cn: 考古学家：通过遗址、器物、遗骸和其他物质证据研究过去人类社会的人。
notes.summary_en: An archaeologist studies past human life by examining physical remains such as tools, buildings, bones, seeds, and objects found at sites.

notes.title: arrange
notes.summary_cn: 提前计划并确保某件事发生。
notes.summary_en: To arrange is to plan something so that it can happen, or to put things into a clear order or position.

notes.title: attract
notes.summary_cn: 吸引：使人、动物或物体靠近或产生兴趣。
notes.summary_en: To attract is to draw a person, animal, object, attention, or interest toward something because of force, appeal, value, or importance.

notes.title: audience
notes.summary_cn: 观众；听众；读者群
notes.summary_en: An audience is the group of people who watch, listen to, or read something, especially the people a message is meant to reach.

notes.title: bench
notes.summary_cn: 长凳；工作台
notes.summary_en: A bench can be a long seat, a work surface, the group of judges in a court, or the place for reserve players. As a verb, it can mean taking someone out of active play.

notes.title: blaze
notes.summary_cn: 熊熊燃烧的火焰；大火
notes.summary_en: A blaze is a large, bright, strongly burning fire. To blaze is to burn fiercely or shine with great intensity.

notes.title: bore
notes.summary_cn: 作为独立动词：钻孔；使人厌烦
notes.summary_en: Bore can be its own word, meaning to make a hole or make someone feel uninterested. It can also be the past tense of bear, so the original sentence is essential.

notes.title: broadcast
notes.summary_cn: 广播；播送；广泛传播
notes.summary_en: To broadcast is to send audio, video, or information to many people at once. A broadcast is the program or message being sent.

notes.title: brush
notes.summary_cn: 刷子；画笔；毛刷
notes.summary_en: A brush is a tool with bristles. To brush is to clean, smooth, paint, or touch something lightly with a brushing movement.

notes.title: cater
notes.summary_cn: 为活动或群体提供食物和服务。
notes.summary_en: To cater is to provide food for an event or to supply what a particular group needs or wants.

notes.title: cherish
notes.summary_cn: 深深喜爱并悉心珍惜某人或某物。
notes.summary_en: To cherish is to care deeply about someone or something and to keep it valuable in your heart or life.

notes.title: civilization
notes.summary_cn: 文明：一个社会长期形成的组织、文化、技术和制度体系。
notes.summary_en: A civilization is a large, organized society with developed institutions, culture, technology, and shared ways of life; the word can also mean the broader condition of such social development.

notes.title: clue
notes.summary_cn: 名词：帮助解开问题、谜团或理解某事的信息。
notes.summary_en: A clue is a piece of information that helps you solve a problem or understand something that is not yet clear.

notes.title: coincide
notes.summary_cn: 同时发生：两个事件恰好出现在同一时间。
notes.summary_en: To coincide is to happen at the same time, to occupy the same position, or to agree closely with another fact, result, or opinion.

notes.title: collaborative
notes.summary_cn: 由多人、团队或组织共同参与、共同完成的。
notes.summary_en: Collaborative describes work, tools, or people that involve cooperating and creating something together.

notes.title: colonist
notes.summary_cn: 殖民者；殖民地定居者
notes.summary_en: A colonist is a person who settles in a colony, often as part of a political or economic expansion controlled by another power.

notes.title: commission
notes.summary_cn: 委员会；受命处理某项事务的官方机构
notes.summary_en: A commission can be an official group, an assigned piece of work, or money paid for making a sale. To commission something is to formally ask for it to be created or done.

notes.title: conscience
notes.summary_cn: 良心、道德感：让人判断自己的行为是否正确，并可能因错误行为而内疚的内在意识。
notes.summary_en: Conscience is the inner sense that judges whether one's actions are morally right or wrong and can create guilt when one acts against that judgment.

notes.title: consciousness
notes.summary_cn: 意识；对自身和周围环境的觉察
notes.summary_en: Consciousness is the state of being awake and aware, or the inner experience of noticing thoughts, feelings, and the world.

notes.title: consumption
notes.summary_cn: 使用能源、材料、商品或服务的过程和数量。
notes.summary_en: Consumption is the use of resources, goods, energy, food, or drink, especially when the amount used is being measured or discussed.

notes.title: continent
notes.summary_cn: 大陆、洲：地球上非常大的连续陆地区域，如 Asia、Africa。
notes.summary_en: A continent is one of the world's major continuous land areas, commonly identified as Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Australia.

notes.title: contribute to
notes.summary_cn: 成为某个结果的部分原因，可能产生积极或消极影响。
notes.summary_en: To contribute to something is to help cause it or to give time, money, ideas, or work that supports it.

notes.title: convenient
notes.summary_cn: 容易使用、节省时间或不造成困难。
notes.summary_en: Convenient describes something that is easy to use, saves time, or fits a person's needs or schedule well.

notes.title: cosmetic
notes.summary_cn: 形容词：与美容、外表改善有关的。
notes.summary_en: Cosmetic can relate to beauty products or appearance. It can also describe a change that only affects the surface and does not solve the main problem.

notes.title: counterpart
notes.summary_cn: 职位、作用或功能相对应的人或事物
notes.summary_en: A counterpart is a person or thing that has a similar role or function in another place, group, or system.

notes.title: countless
notes.summary_cn: 无数的；多得数不清的
notes.summary_en: Countless means too many to count or an extremely large number of.

notes.title: critical
notes.summary_cn: 关键的、极重要的：会显著影响结果。
notes.summary_en: Critical can describe something extremely important, a situation that is dangerously serious, a judgment that points out faults, or thinking that carefully tests claims and evidence.

notes.title: curate
notes.summary_cn: 策划并组织展览、收藏或内容
notes.summary_en: To curate is to carefully choose, organize, and present items or information for a particular audience or purpose.

notes.title: customize
notes.summary_cn: 根据某个用户、任务或场景的具体需要修改产品、系统或内容。
notes.summary_en: To customize something is to change it so that it better fits a particular person, task, or purpose.

notes.title: diary
notes.summary_cn: 日记；按日期记录个人经历或想法的文字
notes.summary_en: A diary is a dated personal record of events and thoughts, or a book or system used to keep appointments.

notes.title: dip
notes.summary_cn: 浸、蘸：把某物短暂放入液体或软质食物中。
notes.summary_en: To dip is to put something briefly into a liquid or to move downward for a short time. A dip is a small or temporary fall, or a low place in a surface.

notes.title: distort
notes.summary_cn: 改变形状、声音或图像，使其不再准确自然。
notes.summary_en: To distort something is to change its shape, sound, image, or meaning so that it is no longer accurate or true.

notes.title: division
notes.summary_cn: 把整体分开的行为或结果；群体间的分歧。
notes.summary_en: Division means separating something into parts. It can also be a department in an organization, a disagreement between groups, or the mathematical operation of dividing.

notes.title: domestication
notes.summary_cn: 驯化：人类经过许多代选择和繁育，使野生动植物逐渐适合与人类共同生活或满足生产需要的过程。
notes.summary_en: Domestication is the long-term process through which humans shape a wild species by selecting and breeding it for useful or manageable traits.

notes.title: donkey
notes.summary_cn: 驴：一种与马近亲、耳朵较长的家养动物，常用于驮运。
notes.summary_en: A donkey is a strong, long-eared animal related to a horse. People have traditionally used it to carry loads and work in dry or mountainous places.

notes.title: dramatically
notes.summary_cn: 显著地；剧烈地；幅度很大地
notes.summary_en: Dramatically means in a very large, sudden, or noticeable way. It can also describe behavior that seems theatrical.

notes.title: drift
notes.summary_cn: 缓慢漂移；在缺少明确控制或方向时移动
notes.summary_en: To drift is to move slowly without firm control or a clear direction. As a noun, it can be a slow movement or gradual change.

notes.title: dull
notes.summary_cn: 乏味的；无聊的
notes.summary_en: Dull can describe something uninteresting, not bright, not sharp, or not intense. As a verb, it means making something weaker or less clear.

notes.title: dust
notes.summary_cn: 灰尘、粉尘：空气中或表面上的细小干燥颗粒。
notes.summary_en: Dust is very fine dry material that settles on surfaces or floats in the air. As a verb, dust can mean removing such material or lightly covering something with a powder.

notes.title: ebb
notes.summary_cn: 潮水退去；退潮
notes.summary_en: To ebb is to flow back like a falling tide, or to gradually become weaker, smaller, or less intense.

notes.title: echo chamber
notes.summary_cn: 回音室效应；同类观点反复强化、不同意见被过滤的信息环境
notes.summary_en: An echo chamber is an environment where similar opinions are repeated and strengthened while opposing information is rarely heard.

notes.title: endeavor
notes.summary_cn: 名词：需要持续投入和努力的活动或尝试。
notes.summary_en: An endeavor is a serious effort or project. As a verb, it means to try hard to achieve something.

notes.title: enliven
notes.summary_cn: 使更有生气；使更活跃
notes.summary_en: To enliven something is to make it more lively, energetic, colorful, or interesting.

notes.title: enormous
notes.summary_cn: 巨大的；极大的
notes.summary_en: Something enormous is extremely large in size, amount, degree, or effect.

notes.title: enroll
notes.summary_cn: 报名参加；注册加入
notes.summary_en: To enroll is to officially join a course, program, school, or organization, or to register someone for it.

notes.title: equator
notes.summary_cn: 赤道：环绕地球中部、与南北两极距离相等的假想线。
notes.summary_en: The equator is an imaginary circle around the middle of Earth, equally distant from the North and South Poles; similar circles can be defined on other spherical bodies.

notes.title: equid
notes.summary_cn: 马科动物：属于马科的动物，包括马、驴和斑马等。
notes.summary_en: An equid is any member of the horse family, including horses, donkeys, zebras, and their close relatives.

notes.title: equine
notes.summary_cn: 马的、马科的：与马、驴、斑马等马科动物有关。
notes.summary_en: Equine describes horses and related animals, or something connected with them. As a noun, it can refer to an animal of the horse family.

notes.title: esteem
notes.summary_cn: 名词：对某人能力、品格或成就的高度尊重。
notes.summary_en: Esteem is strong respect and admiration for someone. As a verb, it means to respect someone greatly or formally consider something in a certain way.

notes.title: ethical
notes.summary_cn: 与判断行为对错的道德原则有关。
notes.summary_en: Ethical describes behavior or decisions that follow accepted principles of right, fairness, and responsibility.

notes.title: evolutionary
notes.summary_cn: 进化的、与生物进化有关的。
notes.summary_en: Evolutionary describes biological evolution or any gradual process in which something changes and develops over a long period.

notes.title: fiction
notes.summary_cn: 小说；虚构文学
notes.summary_en: Fiction is writing or storytelling created from imagination rather than presented as factual history.

notes.title: financial
notes.summary_cn: 与资金、收入、支出、投资或金融机构有关的。
notes.summary_en: Financial describes matters related to money, income, costs, investment, or the management of funds.

notes.title: genetic
notes.summary_cn: 遗传的、与基因有关的：由基因影响，或涉及遗传物质和遗传关系。
notes.summary_en: Genetic describes genes, inherited biological information, or traits and relationships that are influenced by that information.

notes.title: genome
notes.summary_cn: 基因组：一个生物体或细胞所包含的完整遗传物质。
notes.summary_en: A genome is the complete set of genetic material carried by an organism or cell, including the DNA needed for its structure, development, and biological functions.

notes.title: glut
notes.summary_cn: 过剩、供过于求：某种商品、信息或资源多到超过需求。
notes.summary_en: A glut is an excessive supply of something, especially more than a market or group can use. To glut a market is to fill it with too much of that thing.

notes.title: guild
notes.summary_cn: 行会、同业协会：历史上由同一行业的工匠或商人组成、制定规则并保护成员利益的组织。
notes.summary_en: A guild is an organized group of people who share a trade, profession, craft, or activity and cooperate to set standards, protect interests, or work toward common goals.

notes.title: handle
notes.summary_cn: 处理；应对；操作
notes.summary_en: To handle something is to deal with, control, or operate it. A handle is the part designed to be held, or sometimes a name used online.

notes.title: hazard
notes.summary_cn: 名词：可能造成伤害、损失或事故的危险因素。
notes.summary_en: A hazard is something that can cause harm. As a verb, it means to risk saying or doing something when the result is uncertain.

notes.title: herder
notes.summary_cn: 牧民、放牧者：照料并驱赶成群牲畜的人。
notes.summary_en: A herder is a person who looks after and moves a herd of animals such as cattle, sheep, goats, horses, or donkeys.

notes.title: imitation
notes.summary_cn: 复制某人的动作、声音、风格或方法。
notes.summary_en: Imitation is the act of copying someone or something, or an object made to look like the real one.

notes.title: incentive
notes.summary_cn: 激励、动力：使人愿意采取某种行动的原因。
notes.summary_en: An incentive is a reason, reward, or benefit that encourages a person or organization to take a particular action.

notes.title: infinite
notes.summary_cn: 无限的；无穷的
notes.summary_en: Infinite means having no end, limit, or measurable boundary.

notes.title: insight
notes.summary_cn: 深刻理解、洞察力：看清复杂问题内部机制的能力。
notes.summary_en: Insight is a clear and deep understanding of a person, problem, or situation, or a useful new idea gained from such understanding.

notes.title: intertwine
notes.summary_cn: 缠绕在一起：两条或多条细长物彼此绕合。
notes.summary_en: To intertwine is to twist things together or to connect ideas, events, or lives so closely that they become difficult to separate.

notes.title: introduce
notes.summary_cn: 让彼此不认识的人相识；首次介绍某个主题。
notes.summary_en: To introduce is to present a person or idea for the first time, or to bring something new into use.

notes.title: investigate
notes.summary_cn: 调查：系统查明事件、问题或可能违法行为的事实。
notes.summary_en: To investigate something is to examine it carefully and systematically in order to discover facts, causes, or an explanation.

notes.title: laboratory
notes.summary_cn: 实验室；进行科学实验、测试或分析的场所
notes.summary_en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific experiments, measurements, tests, or careful technical work.

notes.title: mandate
notes.summary_cn: 授权；委托；正式职责
notes.summary_en: A mandate is official authority or a formal instruction to do something. To mandate something is to require it by rule or authority.

notes.title: manual
notes.summary_cn: 手工的；手动操作的；体力劳动的
notes.summary_en: Manual describes work or control done by hand rather than automatically. As a noun, a manual is a book of instructions.

notes.title: melodramatic
notes.summary_cn: 过分煽情的、夸张戏剧化的：情绪、语言或行为强烈到显得不自然。
notes.summary_en: Melodramatic describes speech, behavior, or a story that presents emotion and conflict in an exaggerated way, often making a situation seem more dramatic than it really is.

notes.title: mock
notes.summary_cn: 嘲笑；以轻蔑方式模仿
notes.summary_en: To mock someone is to make fun of them in an unkind way. Mock can also describe something made for practice or imitation rather than real use.

notes.title: narrate
notes.summary_cn: 按事件顺序讲述故事、经历或过程。
notes.summary_en: To narrate is to tell a story or describe a series of events, often in a clear order or as a voice-over.

notes.title: narrow
notes.summary_cn: 狭窄的：宽度很小。
notes.summary_en: Narrow describes something with little width or limited range. As a verb, it means to make a space, gap, choice, or focus smaller.

notes.title: navigate
notes.summary_cn: 导航、确定路线：控制船、飞机或车辆到达目的地。
notes.summary_en: To navigate is to find and follow a route through a place, system, or difficult situation, sometimes while guiding a vehicle or another person.

notes.title: newness
notes.summary_cn: 新颖；新鲜感
notes.summary_en: Newness is the quality of being new, recent, unfamiliar, or fresh to someone.

notes.title: niche
notes.summary_cn: 生态位；适合某人或某物的特定位置
notes.summary_en: A niche is a specialized place, role, or market where a person, product, or species fits particularly well.

notes.title: peak
notes.summary_cn: 山峰、尖顶：山或形状的最高部分。
notes.summary_en: A peak is the highest point of a mountain, shape, amount, or activity. As a verb, something peaks when it reaches its highest level; as an adjective, peak describes that busiest or strongest level.

notes.title: perception
notes.summary_cn: 通过感官察觉和理解外界信息的过程。
notes.summary_en: Perception is the way we notice and interpret information, or the opinion and impression we form about something.

notes.title: perpetuate
notes.summary_cn: 使某种情况、观念或做法持续很长时间，常用于问题、偏见或错误循环。
notes.summary_en: To perpetuate something is to make it continue for a long time, especially when it is a problem, belief, or pattern.

notes.title: persuade
notes.summary_cn: 说服；使某人相信或同意
notes.summary_en: To persuade someone is to make them agree, believe something, or take action by giving reasons or appealing to their feelings.

notes.title: pinpoint
notes.summary_cn: 精确确定、查明：找出准确位置、时间、原因或对象。
notes.summary_en: To pinpoint something is to identify its exact position, time, cause, or nature. The noun and adjective uses emphasize a very small or precisely defined point.

notes.title: pioneer
notes.summary_cn: 先驱；开拓者
notes.summary_en: A pioneer is one of the first people to explore or develop an area. To pioneer something is to introduce or develop it before it becomes common.

notes.title: plenty
notes.summary_cn: 大量、充足：数量足够，通常还有余量。
notes.summary_en: Plenty means enough or more than enough of something, especially when the available amount removes any need to worry about shortage.

notes.title: preservation
notes.summary_cn: 防止某物损坏、消失或发生不希望的变化。
notes.summary_en: Preservation is the act of protecting something so that it remains safe, usable, or close to its original condition.

notes.title: prior to
notes.summary_cn: 表示某件事发生在另一事件或时间点之前，语气较正式。
notes.summary_en: Prior to means before a particular time or event, especially in formal writing.

notes.title: procedure
notes.summary_cn: 为完成任务而按顺序执行的一套正式步骤。
notes.summary_en: A procedure is an established series of steps for completing a task, or a medical action performed for diagnosis or treatment.

notes.title: propel
notes.summary_cn: 推进：用力使物体向前移动。
notes.summary_en: To propel something is to drive it forward, either by physical force or by giving a person, idea, or process the energy to advance quickly.

notes.title: prospect
notes.summary_cn: 名词：未来发生或成功的可能性、前景；潜在客户或候选对象。
notes.summary_en: A prospect is a possible future situation or a chance of success. It can also mean a person who may become a customer, while the verb means to search for valuable resources.

notes.title: provocative
notes.summary_cn: 故意引起愤怒、争议或强烈反应的。
notes.summary_en: Provocative describes something that is likely to cause a strong reaction, either by challenging people or by making them think deeply.

notes.title: pursue
notes.summary_cn: 追赶、追踪：跟在某人或某物后面试图抓住。
notes.summary_en: To pursue is to follow someone in order to catch them, or to keep working toward a goal, activity, career, or line of inquiry over time.

notes.title: recall
notes.summary_cn: 动词：记起过去的信息或经历；要求产品、人员等返回。
notes.summary_en: To recall is to bring information back to mind or to call something back. As a noun, recall is the ability or act of remembering or returning a product.

notes.title: reflect
notes.summary_cn: 显示或体现某种事实、性质或变化。
notes.summary_en: To reflect can mean to show a fact or quality, to send light or sound back, or to think carefully about an experience.

notes.title: regardless of
notes.summary_cn: 表示某个事实或条件不会改变决定、结果或行动。
notes.summary_en: Regardless of means that something does not change a decision or result, even if it might normally matter.

notes.title: reserve
notes.summary_cn: 动词：预订座位、房间等；保留某物供特定用途。
notes.summary_en: To reserve something is to keep it for a particular person, time, or purpose. A reserve is an extra supply kept for future need.

notes.title: result from
notes.summary_cn: 表示某个结果由后面的原因产生，相当于“源于、由……造成”。
notes.summary_en: If something results from a cause, it happens because of that cause.

notes.title: reveal
notes.summary_cn: 揭示、显示：让原本不清楚的信息或特征变得可见。
notes.summary_en: To reveal something is to make previously hidden, unknown, or unclear information visible or known. As a noun, a reveal is the moment something is publicly shown.

notes.title: revenue
notes.summary_cn: 收入；收益，尤指企业或政府在扣除成本前取得的款项
notes.summary_en: Revenue is the money a business, organization, or government receives from its normal activities before costs are taken away.

notes.title: scar
notes.summary_cn: 伤疤；创伤留下的痕迹
notes.summary_en: A scar is a lasting mark left after a wound heals. The word can also describe a lasting emotional or physical effect.

notes.title: seize
notes.summary_cn: 突然或用力抓住某物；依法扣押或强行控制。
notes.summary_en: To seize is to take hold of something quickly or by force, or to make immediate use of an opportunity.

notes.title: sentiment
notes.summary_cn: 对某件事持有的看法或感受，常指群体态度。
notes.summary_en: A sentiment is a feeling or opinion about something, especially one shared or expressed by a group of people.

notes.title: sequence
notes.summary_cn: 顺序、次序：事物排列或发生的先后关系。
notes.summary_en: A sequence is an ordered series of things or events. As a verb, sequence means to arrange items in order or to determine the order of genetic material.

notes.title: serendipity
notes.summary_cn: 意外发现美好或有价值事物的幸运
notes.summary_en: Serendipity is the happy chance of finding something useful or valuable while looking for something else.

notes.title: sheer
notes.summary_cn: 完全的；十足的，用于强调程度
notes.summary_en: Sheer can emphasize that something is complete or extreme. It can also describe a very steep surface or thin, almost transparent material.

notes.title: shrink
notes.summary_cn: 收缩；缩水；变小
notes.summary_en: To shrink is to become smaller or to make something smaller. It can also mean pulling back because of fear or discomfort.

notes.title: simultaneously
notes.summary_cn: 同时地；在同一时间发生地
notes.summary_en: Simultaneously means happening or being done at the same time.

notes.title: slip away
notes.summary_cn: 悄悄离开：不引人注意地离开某地。
notes.summary_en: To slip away is to leave quietly or to disappear, pass, or become lost gradually. In sensitive contexts, it can be a gentle way to say that someone died.

notes.title: spotlight
notes.summary_cn: 聚光灯：把强光集中照向小范围的灯。
notes.summary_en: A spotlight is a strong light focused on one area; figuratively, it is intense public attention. To spotlight something is to draw special attention to it.

notes.title: startlingly
notes.summary_cn: 惊人地；令人吃惊地
notes.summary_en: Startlingly means in a way that is surprisingly strong, unusual, or sudden enough to catch attention.

notes.title: stethoscope
notes.summary_cn: 听诊器
notes.summary_en: A stethoscope is a medical instrument used to listen to sounds inside the body, especially the heart and lungs.

notes.title: stuff
notes.summary_cn: 东西、材料：非正式地统称物品或物质。
notes.summary_en: Stuff is an informal general word for things, material, or activities whose exact names are unnecessary. As a verb, it means to fill a space tightly or push something into it.

notes.title: suspend
notes.summary_cn: 暂停、中止：暂时停止活动、服务、规则或判断。
notes.summary_en: To suspend something is to stop it temporarily, remove a person's rights for a period, hang it from above, or keep small particles floating in a substance.

notes.title: suspicion
notes.summary_cn: 没有充分证据却认为某事可能为真的想法。
notes.summary_en: A suspicion is a belief or feeling that something may be true or that someone may have done something wrong, even though there is not enough proof.

notes.title: sympathetic
notes.summary_cn: 有同情心的；表示理解的
notes.summary_en: Sympathetic often means showing understanding and care for someone's difficulties, or being generally supportive of an idea.

notes.title: tailor
notes.summary_cn: 动词：针对特定人、目标或场景调整内容、服务或方案。
notes.summary_en: To tailor something is to adapt it for a particular person or purpose. A tailor is a person who makes or changes clothes.

notes.title: tame
notes.summary_cn: 驯服：使一只动物不再惧怕人、较易控制。
notes.summary_en: To tame an animal is to make it calmer and more manageable; more broadly, to tame something is to bring a difficult force or problem under control. As an adjective, tame means not wild or not very exciting.

notes.title: testimony
notes.summary_cn: 证词、证言：证人在法庭或正式调查中陈述的内容。
notes.summary_en: Testimony is a formal statement about what someone knows or experienced, especially in court; it can also be evidence that clearly demonstrates a fact or quality.

notes.title: the rest of
notes.summary_cn: 其余的、剩下的：在已经提到或取出一部分之后，指未包含的部分。
notes.summary_en: The rest of means the part or people that remain after one part has already been mentioned, used, removed, or separated.

notes.title: transferable
notes.summary_cn: 可转移、可转让的：权利、票据、资金或所有权能交给其他人或地方。
notes.summary_en: Transferable describes something that can be moved, passed to another owner, or applied successfully in a different job, place, or situation.

notes.title: tune
notes.summary_cn: 曲调；旋律
notes.summary_en: A tune is a simple melody. To tune something is to adjust it so that it sounds or works correctly.

notes.title: unattainable
notes.summary_cn: 无法实现、达到或获得的，通常因为目标超出现实条件。
notes.summary_en: Unattainable describes a goal, standard, or object that cannot realistically be reached or obtained.

notes.title: unpretentious
notes.summary_cn: 朴实无华的；不炫耀的
notes.summary_en: Someone or something unpretentious is simple, natural, and not trying to seem more important, expensive, or sophisticated than it really is.

notes.title: vehicle
notes.summary_cn: 用于运送人或物的交通工具。
notes.summary_en: A vehicle is a machine used for transport. Figuratively, it is a means through which an idea, message, or goal is carried forward.

notes.title: verbatim
notes.summary_cn: 逐字地；一字不差地
notes.summary_en: Verbatim means using exactly the same words as the original, without paraphrasing or changing them.

notes.title: volume
notes.summary_cn: 体积、容积：物体或空间占据的三维大小。
notes.summary_en: Volume can mean the amount of three-dimensional space something occupies, the total quantity of activity or material, the loudness of sound, or one book in a set.

notes.title: whistle
notes.summary_cn: 口哨声；哨子
notes.summary_en: A whistle is a clear, high sound made by blowing air, or a small device that makes that sound. To whistle is to produce it.
